experiments.scope: Exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 root compression on 64-byte messages. Per organizer seed, one run of Steps 1-6 of proof.md Section 2 scaled to a 16-bit point (two bits in each of the eight walk lanes, the other message bits fresh per-trial coins and a fresh salt in words 8-15), distinguished points on the two lane-0 bits, k' = 2^8, g = 2^5. Every organizer trial is returned, failures as two nulls.
experiments.hypothesis: The success frequency of the scaled program on the real map agrees, within sampling error, with its success probability for a uniformly random function on 2^16 points (0.449 from 10^6 trials of the program's own model mode, proof.md Section 5), as H1 predicts at full scale. Each success is a pair of distinct messages whose digests agree on the low two bits of all eight digest lanes.
